verdict.rationale: Docs describe `$skill-installer` as a mechanism to add individual named curated skills (e.g. `$skill-installer linear`, `$skill-installer gh-address-comments`) rather than requiring the full plugin bundle, and skills-only plugins are explicitly a first-class submission type distinct from full MCP bundles. This directly matches picking specific skills from a collection rather than installing everything.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that selecting a subset of skills from a marketplace plugin (vs. the curated skills repo) actually excludes the rest of that plugin's bundled tools, and community validation of this exact selective-install workflow.
